name: Doka DokaXbot Lift
summary: Semi-automated robot for the DokaXdek slab formwork. It lifts and places formwork panels with their floor props from the ground, up to 5.7 m working height, remote-controlled so no one stands under the load.

germany.statusNote: Doka says the robot is initially available as a rental product after bauma 2025 and invites site tests through a contact form. Doka's German site says it has more than 150 sales and logistics locations, 14 of them in Germany, and the DokaXdek reference list names projects in Munich and Augsburg; no price or rental rate is published.

sellers.name: Doka Germany (sales and logistics locations)
sellers.note: Rental on request; the product page has an enquiry form and offers to test the robot at your construction site. The legal name of the German sales company was not checked.

specs.label: Working height
specs.quote: With a working height of up to 5.7 metres

specs.label: Operation
specs.value: remote operation from the ground; tablet for parameters; RFID card access
specs.quote: enables remote operation from a safe distance

specs.label: Positioning
specs.value: automatic height adjustment and sensor-supported fine positioning
specs.quote: automatic height adjustment and sensor-supported fine positioning

notes: Wheels is an assumption from the maker's 'quick traversing to the next position' and 'door-entry capable'; the running gear is not described.
It works on the slab itself and compensates floor deviations; rough ground is set false because it is a slab-level machine.
Handles DokaXdek panels with their floor props; it is a lifting machine, not a free arm, so arms are 0.
Doka calls it semi-automated: an operator drives and releases it from the ground.
